hero.lede: I build web products end to end — from React & Next.js interfaces down to the Node, Nest and database layer that powers them.

about.label: About
about.p1: I'm a full-stack developer who likes owning the whole slice of a feature. On the front I reach for React and Next.js; on the back I work with Node and NestJS, and I'm comfortable designing and querying the database that sits under it all.
about.p2: What I care about: clean data models, interfaces that feel fast, and code the next person can actually read.
